transcript.message: Jake, Lum from Outsorcy, cold call, thirty seconds. You posted an SDR role, sixty-five to seventy-five OTE. We place full-time SDRs from our office in Kosovo for a fixed fee of about thirty-five hundred a month. Is that role real?
Not really. I pay fourteen hundred a month for a guy who does this already. Why would I pay two and a half times that?
Fair. What's he getting you for the fourteen hundred, and how long has he been with you?
Year and a half. He's solid, books what I need, and honestly the real pipeline comes from partners. The post is me keeping an eye on the market.

Then I'd be wasting your money. At fourteen hundred with someone who's stuck around eighteen months, keep him. Where we fit is the day you decide to hire a real in-house SDR and look at the loaded cost. When do you think that decision comes up, realistically?
Probably when we raise next. Call it spring.
Okay. Can I call you the first week of March, and if the raise slips you tell me to get lost?
Sure. First week of March. Sounds good.
Appreciate it, Jake. Good luck with the raise.
